title: Important to understand the mounts are suction cups, even though they look like adhesives...
text: Important to understand the mounts are suction cups, even though they look like adhesives.... I wanted to use these between our two bathroom sinks, but I realized our wall is textured, so I'm not sure how the suction cups would work. I thought they were adhesives, that's why I got them, but they turn out to be some sort of squared suction cup. So we'll probably look for a different location. Stock photos look much better than reality. Each caddy has this little white mark, which indicates where the mold was separated. You can also see some sort of weathering in the plastic, like it's been used. It looks like something you'd fine at the dollar store, or browsing Ross, Marshalls. I mean it is what it is and will serve it's purpose. Just a little disappointed it's not as shiny and polished as the stock photos. On the bright side, it's also a puzzle game! After taking out the contents, try putting everything back in. LOL! I give this 3 stars.
